mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, address_name AS addressName, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, zip_code AS zipCode, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, latitude, longitude, is_default AS isDefault, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, address_name AS addressName, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, zip_code AS zipCode, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, latitude, longitude, is_default AS isDefault, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_addresses (user_id, address_name, recipient_name, recipient_phone, zip_code, address, detail_address, latitude, longitude, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{addressName}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{isDefault})
